name: AI Agents for Science
blurb: Agentic platforms that plan and run parts of the research process.
title: AI Agents for Science
answer: AI agents now search literature, generate hypotheses, plan experiments and in some cases order lab work. Cloud providers have entered: Amazon Bio Discovery combines biology foundation models with an agent interface and connected lab services in a closed loop.

reading.body:
AI agents in science work best on narrow, well specified steps, with a scientist approving each experiment the agent proposes.

The pattern in the data is a division of labor rather than autonomy. Agents search literature, generate hypotheses, and plan experiments, but the stated guidance keeps a human approving each proposed experiment. The one named platform, Amazon Bio Discovery, combines biology foundation models with an agent interface and connected lab services in a closed loop, which is the shape to watch: models plus an agent layer plus physical lab work.

That closed loop matters for AI because the agent is only one component. Foundation models supply the prediction, and connected lab services supply the execution. When the loop closes, the constraint shifts toward the physical side, the instruments and the wet lab that actually run the experiments.

The data does not say how many agents are deployed, how often they are correct, or what any of this costs. It covers one platform and one piece of operating advice, so it describes a direction rather than a measured trend.
